Full Tracklist Revealed for Upcoming Soundtrack

Reports indicate that the complete tracklist for the companion double album to the upcoming film *The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping* has been released. Distributed by MCA Records and executive produced by Grammy-winning producer Dave Cobb, the album features contributions from 29 cross-genre artists.

Among the previously announced tracks—such as Noah Kahan’s “Draw You Out” and Gigi Perez’s “Favor”—is The Smashing Pumpkins’ song “Black Stars,” which debuted ahead of the full tracklist announcement.

Featured Artists on the Soundtrack

The double album brings together a diverse lineup of musicians. Selected tracks and contributors reported in the tracklist include:

  • The Smashing Pumpkins – “Black Stars”
  • Noah Kahan – “Draw You Out”
  • Gigi Perez – “Favor”
  • Stevie Nicks – “Doing The Best That I Can (Arena Mix)”
  • The Cure – “Alone (Live in Berlin 2022)”
  • Depeche Mode & KÁRYYN – “Survive (Arena Mix | KÁRYYN Rework)”
  • Jennifer Lawrence – “Deep in the Meadow”
  • Kacey Musgraves – “Ruthless (Arena Mix)”
  • Tyler Childers – “Old Money”

Background on ‘Black Stars’ and Production

Frontman Billy Corgan reportedly worked with producer Butch Vig to select a track that fit the atmosphere of Panem during the 50th Hunger Games and the second Quarter Quell. The accompanying music video for “Black Stars” features purple smoke elements that match visual motifs found in trailers for the film.

Release Schedule and Verification

  • Album Release Date: Scheduled for November 13, preceding the film.
  • Film Theatrical Release: Scheduled for November 20.

Readers and fans interested in verifying official announcements can consult MCA Records, official film social media channels, or distributor updates closer to the release dates.
